title: Integrated transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses to decipher the regulatory mechanisms of polystyrene nanoplastic-induced metabolic disorders in hepatocytes
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00161G, Paper
Yuting Fang, Yukang Zhang, Tingting Wei, Huraira Akhtar, Yuqing Song, Yajie Wang, Man Yang, Rongzhang Hao, Yanbo Li, Zhiwei Sun, Ji Wang
This study reveals that PSNPs disrupt hepatocyte lipid and amino acid metabolism and identifies key genes using an integrated omics approach. It provides data for understanding MNP hazards and assessing health risks.
